experiment: E6 emission-rule sweep (value scaling x emitted volume) on the hide-and-recover holdout

evaluator.name: gems53.core.dti
evaluator.formula: TI = TPw/(TPw + 0.2 FPw + 0.8 FNw + eps); triangular kernel R=3 px (300 m); dti() refactored into kernel_to_gt + dti_with_kernel (shared-tool change, tests pass)
evaluator.unit_test: tests/test_metric.py (matches literal brute force; rules worked example)

label_type: HOLDOUT-DTI (proxy: withheld known-fault segments; NOT organizer-scored)
model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.1, max_leaf_nodes=31, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=0); 19 label-free bands; 300k sampled negatives per fold

reproduction_check.rule: raw variant at q in {0.005, 0.0073, 0.01, 0.02} must reproduce the Exp 2 bands arm exactly
